sections.heading: MINOR IN HISTORY
lines: History - Faculty of Arts and Social Science
Completion of first-year requirements, including at least 0.5 course in History with a mark of at least 60%.
4.0 courses in History at the 2000 level or above, only one of which may be at the 2000-2199 level.
Note: Enrolment in History 3801E and all 4000 level History courses is restricted to students who have met the progression requirements for the Honours B.A.
